mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over two consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises by >0.25% month-over-month for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10) during periods when this trigger is met in at least three out of the last five tightening episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% for three consecutive months signals a late-cycle labor market, where wage inflation accelerates and profit margins compress, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10) during periods when UNRATE remains below 5% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in both personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) for two consecutive months indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both decline month-over-month for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10) during periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average by more than 2% for three consecutive months signals a supply-side expansion, which boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.10) during periods when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average by >2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both CPIAUCSL (inflation) and FEDFUNDS above their respective 12-month averages signals a dual inflationary and restrictive policy regime, which increases uncertainty and reduces equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS both exceed 12-month moving average in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10) during months when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS exceed their 12-month averages.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) of more than 200,000 jobs signals a tight labor market, which raises wage pressures and input costs, ultimately leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days in a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6%).
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10) during months when PAYEMS increases by >200,000 and UNRATE > 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in real personal savings (RSAFS) below its 12-month average for four consecutive months signals reduced household financial buffer, which dampens consumer spending and corporate revenue prospects, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < 12-month moving average for four consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10) during periods when RSAFS is below its 12-month average for four consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both the industrial production index (INDPRO) and capacity utilization (implied by INDPRO relative to historical peaks) above 85% signals an overextended manufacturing sector, raising the risk of supply bottlenecks and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 85% of estimated capacity for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10) during periods when INDPRO exceeds 85% of estimated capacity for two consecutive months.
